event_amp = min(peak - thresh, sat_cap) / sat_cap  ->  dimensionless [0, 1]

a_evt=0.02, b_evt=0.01 -> ca_event_thresh ~ 0.02*0.09 ~ 1.8 uM for Cpre~0.09
cai peak at 10Hz ~ 4 uM   -> above thresh -> rising edge detected
cai trough at 10Hz ~ 0.1-0.5 uM -> below thresh -> falling edge fires event
Result: one clean event_amp~1.0 per spike (peak 4uM >> sat_cap 2uM)
sat_cap = 0.002 mM = 2 uM  (normalization reference, ~EPSP Ca excess)
EPSP peak excess over thresh < 2 uM  -> partial event [0, 1)
bAP  peak excess over thresh >> 2 uM -> event capped at 1.0
-> bAPs do not super-prime relative to strong EPSPs
